title: Red Clover Extract for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Red Clover for Hair Loss: Trial Evidence & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: What a randomized trial of a red clover-containing scalp product, a herbal hair loss review and a safety trial show about red clover and hair.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (0 study links) made unsourced claims. Rewritten around a placebo-controlled trial of a combination, a review and a safety trial.
flags: The human trial tested red clover with a peptide; the article says so.
Mentions androgenetic-type hair loss ('recessing hair') and breast cancer family history (safety trial population); informational.
'Often for menopausal symptoms' and 'used in some cosmetic products' are general; the Loing trial confirms cosmetic use.
